mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level consistently compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 2.5% is followed by negative 20d SPX returns in more than 60% of observations over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth concerns intensify.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, the 20d SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in labor market (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS above 137,000 and RSAFS above 380,000 is followed by negative 20d SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months), the 20d SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105.0, the 20d SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal increased consumer confidence and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates near-term growth.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 5d SPX returns is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE) and weak employment growth (PAYEMS) indicate a struggling labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5% and PAYEMS falls below 137,000, the 60d SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI index above 216.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market concerns about central bank tightening and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 216.0, the 20d SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
